top_signals.title: Yen Rallies as Intervention, BOJ Rate Risk Weigh on Traders
top_signals.summary: The yen strengthened 2% Thursday, reversing a month of gradual decline, as traders lifted bets on Japanese interest-rate hikes and were on high alert to the risk of authorities wading back into the market to boost the currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Stocks Rise, Bond Yields Fall on Waller’s Remarks: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks rose and bond yields fell as Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller offered some optimism that price pressures were showing signs of improvement, adding he’d be willing to support holding rates in September.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Nvidia buys Hugging Face for $12.9B in push into AI software
top_signals.summary: Nvidia agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, gaining a platform used by more than 18 million developers to share and deploy AI models.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Saudi Firm Humain Eyes $2.5 Billion Fund to Build Data Centers
top_signals.summary: Artificial intelligence firm Humain is planning to raise an initial $2.5 billion from global and domestic investors for a fund to invest in data centers in Saudi Arabia, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
